records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2023 increased $6.6 million, or 1.9%, compared to the three months ended September 30, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Favorable price/mix provided 1.2% of the net revenue growth driven by net price realization, and volume provided 0.7% of the growth.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Compared to the same period last year, SBG net revenue increased $8.1 million, or 2.6%, while cookies net revenue decreased $1.5 million, or 3.9%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Favorable price/mix driven by previously taken pricing actions and product mix provided 8.6% of the net revenue growth, offset by a 5.5% decline from volume.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash flows provided by operating activities for the nine months ended September 30, 2023 and 2022 were $143.2 million and $164.2 million, respectively.
